env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cd w
# A comptime generic may name the unexported identifiers of its own
# package, so the defining package builds (SPEC 2.5, T-205).
logos build ./app
# An instantiation in another package cannot reach them. It fails at the
# importer's instantiation and names each identifier; the importer never
# sees an undefined: name.
! logos build ./...
stderr 'main[/\\]main.lgo:14:\d+: \[comptime::unexported_in_exported\] comptime source names unexported type named of package example.com/cfrepro/app; only that package can instantiate it'
stderr 'main[/\\]main.lgo:14:\d+: \[comptime::unexported_in_exported\] comptime source names unexported func collect of package example.com/cfrepro/app; only that package can instantiate it'
! stderr 'app[/\\]app.lgo'
! stderr 'undefined'

cd ../m
# Package main instantiates its own exported comptime generic, which
# names an unexported function of the package; the program runs.
logos run .
stdout '^2$'
cd ../x
# The issue's exact shape: an external test package instantiates the
# generic with a field-type argument and a field projection. The
# defining package builds; the external test package is another package,
# so its instantiation fails there.
logos build ./...
! logos test ./...
stderr 'app_test.lgo:11:\d+: \[comptime::unexported_in_exported\] comptime source names unexported type named of package example.com/x/app; only that package can instantiate it'
stderr 'app_test.lgo:11:\d+: \[comptime::unexported_in_exported\] comptime source names unexported func collect of package example.com/x/app; only that package can instantiate it'
! stderr 'undefined'

-- w/go.mod --
module example.com/cfrepro

go 1.27

-- w/app/app.lgo --
package app

import "comptime"

type named struct {
	name string
}

func collect[F any](parts []named, name string, field F) []named {
	return parts
}

func Run[T any](root *T) int {
	var parts []named
	var out []named
	const for _, f := range comptime.Fields[T]() {
		out = append(out, collect[[]byte](parts, f.Name, nil)...)
	}
	return len(out)
}

-- w/main/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"example.com/cfrepro/app"
	"fmt"
)

type Root struct {
	Port int
	Host string
}

func main() {
	fmt.Println(app.Run[Root](&Root{}))
}

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/cfmain

go 1.27

-- m/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"comptime"
	"fmt"
)

type pair struct {
	A int
	B int
}

func parse(i int) int {
	return i * 2
}

func Load[T any]() int {
	sum := 0
	const for _, f := range comptime.Fields[T]() {
		sum += parse(f.Index)
	}
	return sum
}

func main() {
	fmt.Println(Load[pair]())
}

-- x/go.mod --
module example.com/x

go 1.27

-- x/app/app.lgo --
package app

import "comptime"

type named struct{ name string }

func collect[F any](parts []named, name string, field F) []named {
	return append(parts, named{name: name})
}

func Run[T any](root *T) int {
	var parts []named
	const for _, f := range comptime.Fields[T]() {
		parts = collect[f.Type](parts, f.Name, root.[f])
	}
	return len(parts)
}

-- x/app/app_test.lgo --
package app_test

import (
	"testing"

	"example.com/x/app"
)

type root struct{ A int }

func TestRun(t *testing.T) { _ = app.Run[root](&root{}) }
